profile_text.body:
Obsidian is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Los Angeles, CA, that makes a note-taking and personal knowledge management application. The company describes its product as "the free and flexible app for your private thoughts," emphasizing that notes are stored locally on the user's device, accessible offline, and readable by no one outside the user, not even Obsidian itself. The application supports personal notes, journaling, knowledge bases, and project management, and allows users to create linked connections between notes, visualize those relationships through an interactive graph, and extend functionality through thousands of plugins and an open API. A feature called Canvas provides an open workspace for research, brainstorming, and diagramming.

The site's held facts categorize Obsidian's AI offering as a local-first knowledge AI product, noted for its privacy-focused design and absence of cloud dependency. Two MCP servers associated with Obsidian have been registered in third-party directories: one connects AI assistants to GitHub-hosted Obsidian vaults for access and search, and another enables searching a vault to find notes by title or keyword and summarize related content. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts, though the company carries a California legal exposure entry with 161 associated records.
